extra-slovenia-ljubljana.name: Chabad of Slovenia
extra-slovenia-ljubljana.note: Rabbi Yossi and Rochele Krinsky visited Slovenia over the summer of 2026 and held their first event, a barbecue in Ljubljana ('they expected about 15 people. Instead, some 60 showed up'), then Rosh Hashanah programs (5787); announced as Slovenia's first resident shluchim at the Kinus Hashluchim banquet on 8 Nov 2026 (Chabad.org on CrownHeights.info, 9 Nov 2026; COLlive and ChabadInfo the same day), 'preparing to relocate' under Merkos. Before them Rabbi Ariel Haddad of Chabad of Trieste served Slovenia from Italy. The year is their first activity there (summer 2026, 5786).
